claims: Samsung is discontinuing its native Samsung Messages app and replacing it with Google Messages as the default texting app on Galaxy devices starting in July 2026.
Galaxy S26 and newer models will not support Samsung Messages.
Google Messages will now provide RCS.
Google Messages will now provide AI features.
Google Messages will now provide cross-device support.
Google Messages has a white icon with a blue conversation bubble.
Google Messages will become the default texting app on Galaxy devices.
Most new Samsung phones are already pre-installed with Google Messages.
Users will receive prompts to switch to Google Messages.
Users can manually set Google Messages as default via settings.
Only messages from the past 90 days are guaranteed to transfer.
Google Messages supports better group chat management
